title: ECP Case Qualification (M3-CA0 v1 authoring-layer gate)
description: Deterministic four-state qualification artifact for one candidate case (M3-CA0 v1, 0.5.0). The qualification engine (src/ecp/qualification.py) answers: is this authored candidate structurally complete, ground-truth verifiable, novel within and across populations, leakage-safe, provenance-complete and honestly disclosed enough to enter the QUALIFIED candidate pool (which is still NOT registration)? Exactly one of four decisions is produced — ACCEPT / REVISE / REJECT / INCONCLUSIVE (order §11); ambiguous engine inputs abort the run loudly instead of producing a fifth state. Ground truth is verified MECHANICALLY against the candidate's formal layer (four finite semantics), never by consulting a model. Artifacts are hash-chained per run (prev_qualification_hash) and tamper-evident (artifact_hash = SHA-256 over the ECP-CANONICAL-JSON-1.0 serialization of this document with artifact_hash removed). REJECTED and INCONCLUSIVE candidates remain fully traceable — no silent discards. Real qualification material lives only in a private qualification area; public illustrations under examples/ must use content_class 'format-illustration' fields with real recomputable hashes.

content_class.description: 'review' = real qualification material (private qualification area only). 'format-illustration' = public dummy illustration (examples/ only). The engine refuses illustration inputs.

qualification_id.description: Qualification-layer identity (NOT an ECP-CASE id, NOT an ECP-REG id; neither is ever assigned at this layer).

run_id.description: The qualification run this artifact belongs to.

source_case_id.description: The case id inside the authored source document (e.g. 'N-001').

content_hash.description: The qualified candidate's content hash (R1/Q1 identity link; the engine recomputes and compares).

entry_index.description: 1-based position of this artifact within its run (chain order = candidate order).

prev_qualification_hash.description: Hash of the previous artifact in the run (genesis '0'*64 for the first).

dimensions.description: The eight qualification dimensions (Q1–Q8). Statuses are per-dimension; findings are recorded, never silently resolved.

ground_truth.description: Q3: mechanical verification of the formal layer against the authored ground truth.

verification.description: The deterministic verification result (derived class, method, value, trace summary).

novelty.description: Q4: N1–N6 structural novelty. N1/N2 are recorded OPEN questions (external novelty NOT_ESTABLISHABLE_MECHANICALLY without model invocation or retrieval, both forbidden at CA0); N3 is computed from renaming-invariant structural skeletons; N4 is text-level against the prior format-1 pool; N5/N6 are identifier-registry checks.

skeleton.description: Renaming-invariant skeleton hash (null when not computable).

leakage.description: Q5: the six order §8 leakage classes. A CONFIRMED direct answer leak is disqualifying; risks are recorded. Model leakage is NOT-APPLICABLE-PRE-EXECUTION with the permanent pretraining-exposure declaration.

decision.description: Order §11: exactly one of four states; no fifth state exists (ambiguous engine inputs abort the run loudly).

reason_codes.description: Deterministic codes mapping findings to the decision (precedence REJECT > REVISE > INCONCLUSIVE > ACCEPT, recorded in the run manifest).

forwarded.description: Open questions and designed-ambiguity records forwarded to downstream stages (e.g. FWD-GT-DESIGNED-AMBIGUITY, FWD-GT-UNVERIFIABLE).

artifact_hash.description: SHA-256 over ECP-CANONICAL-JSON-1.0 of this document with artifact_hash removed — tamper evidence re-derivable by any third party.
